idea-plugin.name: Morning Mist Theme
idea-plugin.description:
A light UI theme and editor colour scheme with the colours of the Cool Breeze theme of Visual Studio 2026: a tinted window, light rounded panels with clear outlines, and Visual Studio's C# syntax colours.

  • Colours are decoded from Visual Studio's own theme data and checked against screenshots, not picked by eye. A build of the project writes a colour table that traces every value to its source.
  • Built on JetBrains' Islands Light theme and Visual Studio Light scheme, so every key is a real one.
  • Contains colour values only. No Microsoft artwork, icons or fonts.

Requires JetBrains IDEs 2026.2 or later with the Islands UI. For the closest match set the editor font to Cascadia Mono.

Not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft or JetBrains. Visual Studio is a trademark of Microsoft Corporation; Rider is a trademark of JetBrains s.r.o.

Shared semantic colours for C#, Java, Kotlin, Go and Python, with this theme's own palette and clearly separated panels.
